kick.en: One of these is actually a MYTH. Can you spot it?
kick.zh: 以下其中一項其實是迷思，你能找出來嗎？

text.en: Australian rower Chris Morgan won three Olympic medals before being diagnosed with autism, which is why his condition never affected his career.
text.zh: 澳洲划艇運動員 Chris Morgan 在確診自閉症之前已贏得三面奧運獎牌，所以他的自閉症從未影響他的運動生涯。

reveal.en: Chris Morgan is a three-time Olympian and won bronze at London 2012 — but he says his autism helped him succeed: "Autism made me successful."
reveal.zh: Chris Morgan 三度參與奧運，並在 2012 年倫敦奧運贏得銅牌——但他表示，是自閉症幫助他成功：「自閉症令我成功。」

text.en: Love 21 spent just 15% of its budget on administrative overhead last year.
text.zh: Love 21 去年只將 15% 的預算用於行政開支。

reveal.en: The real figure is 6% — Love 21 directs the rest of every dollar to its programmes for members and families.
reveal.zh: 實際數字是 6%——Love 21 將餘下每一分善款都投放於會員及家庭的服務項目上。

label.zh: Love 21 基金會財務報告（2025 財政年度）

reveal.en: This has been thoroughly debunked. There is no link between vaccines and autism.
reveal.zh: 此說法早已被徹底推翻。疫苗與自閉症之間並無任何關聯。
